N-Bansari.title_core: Women Embroidered Pure Cotton Straight Kurta with Trousers
N-Bansari.description: Elevate your ethnic wardrobe with the Bansari Kurta Set, tailored from soft, breathable pure cotton fabric. Featuring an exquisite yoke embroidery depicting Krishna flute (bansari) and peacock feather motifs with intricate floral borders, this straight-fit kurta is paired with comfortable matching solid trousers. Finished with a flattering sweetheart neckline, 3/4th sleeves with embroidered borders, and side slits, it offers effortless elegance for festive celebrations, devotional gatherings, and daily casual wear.
